final_candidates.decision_summary: G149 is sequence-verified in the catalytic domain. Introducing a charged aspartate at this small-residue position is plausibly strongly disruptive to local structure and enzyme activity.
R157 is sequence-verified in the KNIMALRGDP segment. Loss of the arginine positive charge in the catalytic-domain core is a plausible loss-of-function perturbation.

D188 is sequence-verified in the HIRSEFGDYF segment of the catalytic domain. Neutralizing this acidic residue could impair a required local interaction, although complete activity loss is less certain.
